# chore(hfp-018): upgrade the frontend to Vitest 5

## Task

The frontend uses Vitest `^4.1.5`; `server/` uses `^5.1.0`. Upgrade the root to Vitest 5 so both use the same version and the same docs.

## Parent Story

Pre-existing breakages (found 2026-11-06 in HFP-005).

## Blocked by

Nothing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Root `vitest` (and any `@vitest/*` packages) on Vitest 5; `npm run code-quality` passes.
- [ ] Any Vitest 4-only API or config in `vite.config.ts` and the specs is updated.
- [ ] `.windsurf/skills/vitest-4-reference.md` and the write-unit-test skill are checked for version-specific advice. Update them, or note that they still apply.
- [ ] The jsdom environment stays (switching to Browser Mode is a separate discussion, per CLAUDE.md).
